name: contradicts-relation-add-is-an-ordinary-relation-edit
why: The positive control for the conditional capability, and the mirror of `classify-conflict-is-not-available-yet`. `edit_relation` is gated on `declared_contradiction_authoring` ONLY when the payload says `add` + `contradicts`; M27.4 made that capability available, so the same clause that refused this proposal now lets it through to the ordinary MEDIUM ladder. What the capability buys is not the relation event — that always worked — but the registration, classification, and any open edge that now commit in the SAME batch as it, so a declaration is never durable while unclassified.
